import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()

# Add appcompat theme and fix build.gradle

android {
    namespace 'com.ouroboros.arelorian'
    compileSdk 34
    defaultConfig {
        applicationId "com.ouroboros.arelorian"
        minSdk 21
        targetSdk 34
        versionCode 2
        versionName "1.0.1"
    }
    buildTypes {
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
        }
        debug {
            minifyEnabled false
            debuggable true
        }
    }
    compileOptions {
        sourceCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_11
        targetCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_11
    }
}
dependencies {
    implementation 'androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.6.1'
    implementation 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.12.0'
    implementation 'com.google.android.material:material:1.11.0'
}
'''

# Rebuild
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
nohup /opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Building..." """)
import time

print(stdout.read().decode())
c.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /opt/areloria/client/dist/arelorian.apk")
